# Physical Object

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:PhysicalObject`](gmeow-PhysicalObject.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/PhysicalObject>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/kernel`](../../slices/kernel.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An entity that is a material thing occupying space and time — a device, instrument, vehicle, building, or natural body. Distinct from [`Agent`](gmeow-Agent.md) (which acts and bears responsibility) and [`InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md) (which carries information content). The sortal for pose-bearing, sensor-hosting, and spatially-located things that are not agents.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md), [`gufo:Object`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:PhysicalObject`](gmeow-PhysicalObject.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md), [`gufo:Object`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

    rdfs:label "the working wall clock"@en .

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a material thing that occupies space and time and is not itself an agent — a device, instrument, vehicle, building, sensor host, or natural body that bears a pose or a spatial location.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for acting participants ([`Agent`](gmeow-Agent.md)), for content carriers whose materiality is incidental ([`InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)), and for convention-sustained things ([`SocialObject`](gmeow-SocialObject.md)); the three are disjoint with [`PhysicalObject`](gmeow-PhysicalObject.md) by design.

### How to use

- Type the artifact as [`PhysicalObject`](gmeow-PhysicalObject.md) and hang pose, sensor, and spatial-location relations on it; keep agency and information roles on separate co-located entities rather than overloading the physical sortal.

### Examples

- ex:rover a [`gmeow:PhysicalObject`](gmeow-PhysicalObject.md); [`gmeow:hasPose`](../properties/gmeow-hasPose.md) ex:roverPose.
